decision_study.notes: ADR-0205 replacement development screen following a numerical-refinement refusal. It selects exactly 20 evenly spaced identities after lexicographic symbol/quote-date/expiry ordering per symbol; every selected identity has weight 1/20. It is screen-only: no feature/model promotion follows, because the full 18,616-row panel exceeds the 100,000-chain-row cap. Date-only ETF quotes are after-date-close indicative diagnostics, not executable decisions. Raw GridCurve archives are required. The 0.5-dollar coarse weighted score is checked against a 0.125-dollar grid; each absolute difference must not exceed 0.05 and model ranking must be identical.
